title: Happy llama
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#f4e3c1'/>
    <!-- body shading -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='22' ry='13' fill='#e6d0a8'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <rect x='30' y='80' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e6d0a8'/>
    <rect x='44' y='82' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e6d0a8'/>
    <rect x='58' y='82' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e6d0a8'/>
    <rect x='70' y='80' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e6d0a8'/>
    <!-- tail -->
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='62' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#f4e3c1'/>
    <!-- neck -->
    <rect x='52' y='34' width='14' height='24' rx='6' fill='#f4e3c1'/>
    <rect x='54' y='34' width='6' height='24' rx='3' fill='#e6d0a8'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#f4e3c1'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f9efd8'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='18' rx='3.5' ry='8' fill='#f4e3c1' transform='rotate(-15 52 18)'/>
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='18' rx='1.6' ry='5' fill='#e6d0a8' transform='rotate(-15 52 18)'/>
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='17' rx='3.5' ry='8' fill='#f4e3c1' transform='rotate(10 68 17)'/>
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='17' rx='1.6' ry='5' fill='#e6d0a8' transform='rotate(10 68 17)'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='57' cy='28' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
    <circle cx='67' cy='27' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
    <circle cx='57.8' cy='27.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <circle cx='67.8' cy='26.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <!-- nose & smile -->
    <ellipse cx='76' cy='32' rx='2' ry='1.4' fill='#c98f6e'/>
    <path d='M70 37 Q73 40 76 37' stroke='#c98f6e' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='54' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#f2a9a0'/>
    <circle cx='69' cy='33' r='2' fill='#f2a9a0'/>
    <!-- fluffy wool top -->
    <circle cx='57' cy='20' r='4' fill='#fbf3e2'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='18' r='4' fill='#fbf3e2'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#fbf3e2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
